nodes.label: Agentic Function Calling Architecture
nodes.rationale: Automatically understands intent and triggers system tools without hardcoded keywords — intent-driven tool dispatch rather than pattern-matched keyword routing

nodes.label: Context-Driven Operation Modes
nodes.rationale: Modes (Gaming, Study, Movie, Focus) group related app launches and behaviors under a single user intent, reducing the need for multi-step voice commands and creating reusable activity profiles

nodes.label: Local-First Execution Principle
nodes.rationale: Built for local execution using Ollama and SQLite — no cloud dependency, privacy-preserving, works offline, and keeps user data on-device

nodes.label: Tagalog and English Bilingual Voice Support
nodes.norm_label: tagalog and english bilingual voice support

nodes.label: PyAudio (Microphone Audio)
nodes.rationale: PyAudio cannot be installed with plain pip on Windows; it requires pipwin or a pre-built wheel, which is why the manifest carries a dedicated install note.

nodes.label: Voice Mode
nodes.rationale: Voice conversation is a ChatGPT-style loop: browser Web Speech API STT (Filipino fil-PH first, fallback en-US) feeding a streaming LLM, with a parallel Edge-TTS audio pipeline and instant barge-in on any user speech.

nodes.label: Pomodoro Timer
nodes.rationale: Focus mode starts the 25-minute Pomodoro immediately on chip click without waiting for the LLM, guaranteeing the timer runs even if the model responds slowly.
